newsitem.title: USA: TPG Partners to sell Allied Waste stake.
newsitem.headline: TPG Partners to sell Allied Waste stake.

text.p: Allied Waste Industries Inc said Tuesday that TPG Partners LP and an affiliate have agreed to sell their entire holdings of Allied common stock.

The company said in a statement TPG had agreed to sell its 11,776,765 shares of Allied common stock to Apollo Management, L.P. and Blackstone Capital Partners II Merchant Banking Fund, L.P. in a single transaction, subject to regulatory approval.
Apollo and Blackstone have acquired TPG's holding for investment purposes only and intend to maintain a minority position in Allied and are both expected to name a representative to Allied's Board.
